Introduction

Apeace Onyx5, formerly known as Apeace Onyx, was one of three sub-units of the boy group Apeace. The unit began promotions in September 2012 with seven members: Taewoo, Myungeun, Geonhee, Seunghyuk, Sungho, Hoyoung, and Duhwan. In April 2013, member Hoyoung left and was replaced with new member J.D.

After Apeace went through several lineup changes, eventually reaching a total of 15 members, the units were reorganized into groups of five. With Onyx becoming Onyx5, the new lineup consisted of Hyunsung, Seunghyuk, Sungho, Jinwoo, and Junsik. The group later stopped promoting in sub-units around 2015, following the departures and hiatuses of several members.
